messages.english: Open evidence tools for your saved country.
messages.translation: Vhulani zwishumiswa zwa vhuṱanzi zwa shango ḽe na ḽi vhulunga.
Ṱolani vhuṱanzi ha shango ḽe na ḽi vhulunga

messages.english: Crop planner → Site country and region → Review country evidence
messages.translation: Mudzudzanyi wa zwilimwa → Shango na dzingu ḽa fhethu → Ṱolani vhuṱanzi ha shango

messages.english: Use the country you saved for this site to open its existing evidence dossier. Countries without a dossier show general reference tools. Opening the link does not save country details, approve an agricultural region or enable local crop advice.
messages.translation: Shumisani shango ḽe na ḽi vhulungela fhethu afha u vula faela yaḽo ya vhuṱanzi ine ya vha hone. Mashango a si na faela ya vhuṱanzi a sumbedza zwishumiswa zwa u wana mafhungo nga u angaredza. U vula vhuṱumanyi a zwi vhulungi zwidodombedzwa zwa shango, a zwi tendeli dzingu ḽa vhulimi nahone a zwi vuli ngeletshedzo dza zwilimwa dza fhethu afho.
